Name: Bruh Sounds
Author: ForgedBrass
Description:
You don't want to install this Mod. It almost makes the game unplayable with all of the "Bruhs". But I tell you what, it sure is funny. Swing your ax? Bruh. The sounds of your footsteps? Those are also bruh. Bombs? Bruh. Doors? Bruh. PAIN? BRUH.

You will not be able to escape the BRUH with this sound effect pack.

Replaces every sound effect with the classic "Bruh" sound effect. This is not compatible with any other Custom Music mods probably, as it alters every single sound effect file. For custom ad-hoc compatibilities reach out to me and I will see what I can do.

This will flood your starting screen, but it loads surprisingly fast.
